sections.title: An Independent App Studio
sections.body: MintWave Studio is an independent developer of small Android apps. Each app does one job: size a cable, count down to hatch day, track expiry dates, plan a daily budget or train rhythm-game timing. The calculators and trackers work offline without an account, and iPhone versions of several apps are in progress.
list: Calculators and trackers — Cable Calc, Hatch Day, Days Until, Daily Budget, MultiTimer
Music practice — Rhythm Trainer for rhythm gamers and drummers
Quick games — Shadow Match, Trivia Showtime, ZeroMargin, Steady Hand

sections.title: App Highlights
sections.subtitle: What Every App Has in Common
items: The calculators and trackers keep working without a connection. Your data stays on your phone unless you choose to make a backup.
Open the app and start. There is no sign-up, and the budget and tracking apps never connect to your bank or a cloud service.
Every app is free to download. Pro upgrades are optional. MultiTimer, Days Until and Daily Budget have no ads; the games show occasional ads that Pro removes.

sections.title: How Our Apps Stand Out
items: Features are picked by reading store reviews of our apps and of competing apps, then fixing what users complain about most.
Cable Calc follows IEC 60364-5-52, Hatch Day uses incubation data for 11 bird species, and Rhythm Trainer judges every tap to the millisecond.

sections.title: Our Journey
sections.subtitle: Small Apps, Steady Updates
sections.body: MintWave Studio started with simple Android utilities and games. The apps have since been rebuilt in Flutter, translated into up to 14 languages and paired with free web tools on this site, from a voltage drop calculator to a hatch date calculator.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
items: MintWave Studio is an independent studio that makes small, focused Android apps: offline calculators and trackers (Cable Calc, Hatch Day, Days Until, Daily Budget, MultiTimer), the Rhythm Trainer timing app, and quick puzzle, trivia and reflex games.

Yes. Every app is free to download from Google Play. Optional Pro upgrades add advanced features. MultiTimer, Days Until and Daily Budget have no ads; Rhythm Trainer and the games show occasional ads that Pro removes.
Do the apps work offline and without an account?
Yes. The calculators and trackers work offline and need no account or sign-up. Your data stays on your device, and backups are optional.
Which MintWave app sizes electrical cables?

Cable Calc sizes cables and checks voltage drop to IEC 60364 for metric (mm²) cables, with derating and breaker selection. This site also has a free cable size calculator and a voltage drop calculator.
Which MintWave app tracks egg incubation?

Hatch Day counts down to hatch day for 11 bird species, including chicken, duck, goose, quail and turkey, and reminds you about turning, candling and lockdown. The free hatch date calculator on this site gives the same key dates.
Are MintWave apps available on iPhone?
The apps are available on Google Play for Android. iPhone versions of several apps are in progress.
How do I contact MintWave Studio?
Email support@mintwavestudio.com for help, bug reports or feature requests.
